title: local RAG authoring sandbox with live-reload and TypeScript tool stubs
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: onboard engineers who want a fast local iterate loop for RAG prompt development, tool-calling stubs and interactive debugging without needing a full infra stack. This quickstart provides a minimal local sandbox (browser UI + Node scaffold) with live-reload, a small in-memory vector store, example retriever adapters, and Typescript tool-stub templates that mirror Redwood tool-calling shapes. User-facing goals: (1) immediate feedback on prompt/tool interactions in the browser, (2) ability to swap in a real embedding/DB later, (3) reproducible dev loop for prompt/eval regressions. What changed: added a new quickstart at quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox that contains a web playground (React + Vite), a lightweight Node authoring server with hot-reload, a mock embedders/FAISS-like adapter, and a folder of TypeScript tool stubs for common actions (search-docs, call-rest, cite-source). The README includes a single-command start and a short guide to connect to Redwood Hosted API or local Private. Checklist: - [x] add initial quickstart files and README - [x] implement dev server with live-reload - [x] add TypeScript tool stubs and example tool-calls - [x] include small test harness and smoke tests - [x] CI lint/build passing - [x] docs site entry stub. Commits (summary): 1) add initial project scaffold and README (init commit) 2) implement Node authoring server and live-reload wiring 3) add React playground and example prompt flows 4) add TS tool-stub templates and example adapter 5) add CI smoke test, docs entry and small polish. Changed files (high level): quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/README.md; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/package.json; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/docker-compose.yml; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/authoring-server/src/index.ts; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/webapp/src/App.tsx; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/webapp/src/main.tsx; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/templates/tool-stubs.ts; quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox/test/smoke.spec.ts; docs/quickstarts/index.yml (added listing). Review conversation: "Diego: Nice dev loop, can we keep the embedders adapter interface minimal?"; "Author (Ava): pared down to a 3-method interface — embed, index, query — added comments in adapter.ts"; "Priya: docs README needs a clear security note about not using production secrets in the sandbox"; "Author: added a Security section and a one-click env.example with warnings"; "Samir: CI flaked once on the smoke test in windows runner, re-ran and passed". CI/Checks: linux-node-lint/passed, webapp-build/passed, smoke-tests/passed (rerun after flaky failure). Merge outcome: merged into main on 2024-11-12 via squash-merge. How to use (short): 1) cd quickstarts/rag-authoring-sandbox; 2) cp .env.example .env and set REDWOOD_API_KEY if you want hosted routing; 3) pnpm install && pnpm dev; 4) open http://localhost:5173 and iterate prompts, inspect tool calls, swap adapter to a real embedding provider when ready. Motivation/context links: references ENG-4251 (shortening dev iteration for prompt tuning), internal experiment notes on local dev loops. Release notes: "Add local RAG authoring sandbox with live-reload and TypeScript tool stubs for iterative prompt/tool development."
